text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF ORDERS DIRECTING SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA GAS COMPANY AND PBF ENERGY WESTERN REGION LLC TO RELOCATE OR REMOVE PIPELINES AND CONDUITS INTERFERING WITH THE 22ND STREET PARKING LOT PROJECT AND HARBOR BLVD AND 22ND STREET ROADWAY PROJECT
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the Orders directing City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) tenants Southern California Gas Company (So Cal Gas) and PBF Energy Western Region LLC (PBF), to relocate or remove pipelines that are interfering with the 22nd Street Parking Lot Project and Harbor Boulevard and 22nd Street Roadway Project (Projects). These proposed Orders will serve as a notice to the impacted Harbor Department tenants that they must promptly remove their abandoned pipelines, in accordance with their agreements with the Harbor Department. All costs associated with the removal of affected pipelines are the financial responsibility of the respective tenants.
Recommendation: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed actions is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the Order directing Southern California Gas Company to relocate or remove its pipelines pursuant to Section 9(h) of Order No. 4506; 3) approve the Order directing PBF Energy Western Region LLC to relocate or remove its pipelines pursuant to Section 106.4 of Permit No. 936; 4) authorize the Board Secretary to attest to the Orders directing the aforementioned Harbor Department tenants to relocate or remove their pipelines; and 5) Adopt Resolution No. __________________; and Order Nos. ____________________________.
